revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''阿弥神社'''||アミノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県東茨城郡[[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''阿弥神社'''||アミノ||小|||||||||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小|||||||||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

revision.text:
'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||楯縫神社||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||常陸国[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||[[楯縫神社 (美浦村郷中)|楯縫神社]]||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小||||[[長幡部神社 (常陸太田市)|長幡部神社]]||茨城県[[常陸太田市]]幡町|||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||常陸国[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||[[楯縫神社 (美浦村郷中)|楯縫神社]]||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小||||[[長幡部神社 (常陸太田市)|長幡部神社]]||茨城県[[常陸太田市]]幡町|||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||常陸国[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||[[楯縫神社 (美浦村郷中)|楯縫神社]]||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小||||[[長幡部神社 (常陸太田市)|長幡部神社]]||茨城県[[常陸太田市]]幡町|||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[{{NDLDC|1442211}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||常陸国[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||[[楯縫神社 (美浦村郷中)|楯縫神社]]||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小||||[[長幡部神社 (常陸太田市)|長幡部神社]]||茨城県[[常陸太田市]]幡町|||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

'''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社7座7社（いずれも名神大社）・小社21座20社の計28座27社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[鹿島郡 (茨城県)|鹿島郡]]''' 2座（並大） |- |'''鹿島神宮'''||カシマノ||名神大||月次新嘗||[[鹿島神宮]]||[[茨城県]][[鹿嶋市]][[宮中 (鹿嶋市)|宮中]]||常陸国[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/200101.html] |- |'''大洗礒前薬師菩薩明神社'''||オホアライソザキノヤクシホサツノ-||名神大||||[[大洗磯前神社]]||茨城県[[東茨城郡]][[大洗町]]磯浜町||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/206001.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[真壁郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''大国玉神社'''||オホクニタマノ||小||||[[大国玉神社 (桜川市)|大国玉神社]]||茨城県[[桜川市]]大国玉|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[信太郡]]''' 2座（並小） |- |'''楯縫神社'''||タテヌヒノ||小||||[[楯縫神社 (美浦村郷中)|楯縫神社]]||茨城県[[稲敷郡]][[美浦村]]木原|||| |- |rowspan=2|'''阿弥神社'''||rowspan=2|アミノ||rowspan=2|小||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町竹来)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡[[阿見町]]竹来||||rowspan=2| |- |（論）[[阿彌神社 (阿見町中郷)|阿彌神社]]||茨城県稲敷郡阿見町中郷|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[久慈郡]]''' 7座（大1座・小6座） |- |'''長幡部神社'''||ナカハタヘノ||小||||[[長幡部神社 (常陸太田市)|長幡部神社]]||茨城県[[常陸太田市]]幡町|||| |- |'''薩都神社'''||サチツノ

It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle|lt=Immanuelle|lt_ja=Immanuelle|lt_de=User:Immanuelle|lt_zh=User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle|lt=talk|lt_ja=talk|lt_de=talk|lt_zh=talk}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. On enwiki if you want the templates extract them out of this page to make templates, The jawiki system is too hard[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at [[List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province]] - [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Switching over to deprecating the templates. So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 [[ja:常陸国の式内社一覧]] '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" On enwiki if you want the templates extract them out of this page to make templates, The jawiki system is too hard[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at [[List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province]] - [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=page target for move is at List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=Switching over to deprecating the templates. So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! So things might be a bit unexpected.[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=If this is in the format "List of Shikinaisha in X" then I have linked all existing shrines into the table. Otherwise I have not. Translation of the texts will come later as it is a lot less difficult than the tables. Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''常陸国の式内社一覧'''（ひたちのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[常陸国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 '''Hitachi-koku no Shikinai-sha Ichiran''' (常陸国の式内社一覧) is a list of shrines recorded in volumes 9 and 10 “神名帳上下” of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} – that is, the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳}} – comprising the shrines ({{ill|Jinja|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}), namely the so‐called {{ill|Shikinai Shrines|de|Shikinai Shrines|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}} in Hitachi Province. It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! It also appends those shrines known as {{ill|Shikigai Shrines|de|Shikigai Shrines|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}, which existed at the time of the compilation of the Engishiki Jinmyōchō yet were not recorded in it. == Shikinai Shrines == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft|12=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with [[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[Category:Shikinaisha top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion.[[Category:edited lists]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳}}. [[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|12=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" [[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]][[Category: Lists of Shikinaisha by location top]]This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|12=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|12=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Hitachi Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Hitachi Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Hitachi Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinaisha (式内社) == In the Engishiki Jinmyōchō there are 7 sets of major shrines (all being {{ill|Myojin Taisha shrines|de|Myojin Taisha shrines|ja|Myojin Taisha社|zh|Myojin Taisha社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Myojin Taisha shrines|qq=}}) and 21 sets of minor shrines (20 shrines), making a total of 28 sets with 27 shrines.
